title: Home Purchase Agreement Standard Terms — Buyer Default, Cure and Forfeiture
content:
**§ 15.1 Events of buyer default.** A buyer default under the Home Purchase Agreement is any of: a missed additional deposit; an uncured returned payment; a missed loan application, loan approval or proof of funds deadline; or a buyer delay beyond the collection's buyer delay figure.

**§ 15.2 Notice and cure.** Calloway first sends a default notice. The agreement may be terminated only when at least the collection's cure period (calendar days) has passed since the default notice was sent. Counting starts the day after the notice date, and termination is allowed on the last counted day, provided the default is still uncured. The notice date is read from the default notice entry on the agreement ledger.

**§ 15.3 Forfeiture on termination.** On termination Calloway retains deposits up to the collection's forfeiture cap percent of the contract price, the cap rounded half up to the cent. Deposits are taken toward the cap in this order: the lot premium deposit first, then the additional deposit, then initial earnest money and transferred reservation funds. Any deposit beyond the cap is refunded with the reason excess over forfeiture cap.

**§ 15.4 Charges.** Outstanding charges remain owed after termination.

---

*Annotation A — cure period boundary (hypothetical).* A default notice sent on 3 August with a 10-day cure period: counting runs 4 August through 13 August. If the default is still uncured, termination is allowed on 13 August; on 12 August it is not yet allowed.

*Annotation B — forfeiture (hypothetical figures).* A contract price of 500000.00 with a 7.5 percent cap gives a cap of 37500.00. Deposits held are a lot premium deposit of 20000.00, an additional deposit of 5000.00 and initial earnest money of 15000.00.

| Order | Component | Held | Retained | Running total retained |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Lot premium deposit | 20000.00 | 20000.00 | 20000.00 |
| 2 | Additional deposit | 5000.00 | 5000.00 | 25000.00 |
| 3 | Initial earnest money | 15000.00 | 12500.00 | 37500.00 |

The remaining 2500.00 of initial earnest money is beyond the cap and is refunded with reason excess over forfeiture cap.

*Annotation C — deposits below the cap (hypothetical).* Where the deposits held total less than the cap, every deposit taken in the order above is retained and nothing is refunded as excess.
